Core Beacons displays general CoreBluetooth information and, if advertised by a device, service and/or manufacturer-specific data. Detailed parsing support is available for
• ruuvi sensor tags:
• Format 3 (raw data v1)
• Format 4 (sensor data encoded in Eddystone URL)
• Format 5 (raw data v2)
• Eddystone: UID, URL (incl. Physical Web) & TLM frame types
• mijia temperature & relative humidity sensor beacons (as far as this protocol is documented)
• AltBeacon

Core Beacons may be most useful when working with "beacon" type BLE devices.
